name: Gustavo V. Camacho
office: City of Pico Rivera, Member of the City Council

items.text: Gustavo V. Camacho is the mayor of Pico Rivera and a member of the City Council.

sentences.text: Gustavo V. Camacho is the mayor of Pico Rivera and a member of the City Council.

items.text: His campaign says he focuses on economic development, fiscal responsibility, infrastructure, and homelessness. His campaign also says the city has maintained balanced budgets and a 50% reserve policy. It highlights a $208 million capital improvement program that includes road repairs, a new dog park, and the $39 million Smith Park Aquatic and Community Center. In July 2026, as mayor, he urged Los Angeles County to keep replacement detention capacity as an option before closing Men’s Central Jail, citing concerns about a fixed timeline and insufficient infrastructure.
